series: Zillow Observed Rent Index (ZORI), multi-family 5+ units, smoothed, all units (uc), monthly

j.1: ZIP/ZCTA dominant overlap (not available: Zillow does not publish MF ZORI below metro)
j.3: metro/micro (CBSA) via tract county -> OMB 2023 CBSA delineation -> Zillow metro (name match; 3 hand aliases)
j.4: Zillow micro area matched by county (county in no OMB 2023 CBSA: Jackson NC -> Cullowhee, Rhea TN -> Dayton)

legend.c: j=3: CBSA code as number (5 digits); j=4: county FIPS as number, left-pad to 5 digits

notes: Zillow publishes multi-family ZORI only for metros. Tracts in counties outside a CBSA, or in CBSAs Zillow does not track, are omitted. Every tract in a metro gets the same metro value. See zillow-zori-all-tracts.json for ZIP-level all-homes ZORI.
